# gbc-pixel-editor spritesheet v2
# 256x256 px = 32x32 tiles of 8x8 px. tile index = row*32 + col (0-1023).
# palette N: colors 0-3 as R,G,B (0-255, multiples of 8 = exact RGB555; write them with RGB8(r,g,b)).
# tile: palette row 0-7, flags that are on (- = none), then 8 rows of 8 color indices 0-3 (= PX rows).
# Tiles not listed are empty: every index 0, palette 0, no flags.
# Flags 0-30 by name: 0 SOLID, 1 HAZARD, 2-5 ONEWAY_R ONEWAY_L ONEWAY_U ONEWAY_D, 6-13 SPAWN0-7,
#   14-21 TRIGGER0-7, 22-25 LEAVE0-3, 26-29 ENTER0-3, 30 OVER. Flags 31-63: game-defined (GAME.md).
# flag N NAME color: the human named game-defined flag N (the name is what it means); tiles use NAME.
#   Unnamed ones are written by number. The color is only for the editor.
# Flags are for the AI, not the engine: it turns the ones a game uses into map legend bytes (docs/art-pipeline.md 16.2).

palette 0: 168,216,104 104,168,64 48,112,48 16,48,32
palette 1: 168,216,104 16,48,32 64,120,224 168,208,248
palette 2: 168,216,104 216,216,200 136,136,144 40,40,56
palette 3: 168,216,104 248,248,248 232,72,88 248,208,64
palette 4: 224,200,136 168,216,104 168,120,64 80,48,24
palette 5: 248,0,248 40,24,16 56,160,72 248,200,152
palette 6: 248,0,248 64,16,24 216,72,56 248,176,144
palette 7: 248,0,248 40,24,16 232,56,80 248,248,248
